items.stem: Two features have equal job size. Feature X has far higher cost of delay than Feature Y. Using WSJF, which should be sequenced first?

options.text: Feature X, because WSJF favours higher cost of delay for equal job size
options.rationale: Correct: WSJF = cost of delay / job size; with equal job size the higher cost of delay yields a higher WSJF.

options.text: Feature Y, because smaller cost of delay is safer
options.rationale: WSJF sequences the higher value-per-size first, not the lower cost of delay.
Request order is not a WSJF input.

options.text: Both must wait until the next PI
options.rationale: Nothing in WSJF requires deferring both features.

items.explanation: Correct: WSJF = cost of delay / job size; with equal job size the higher cost of delay yields a higher WSJF.

items.stem: What is the primary purpose of PI objectives written by a team during PI Planning?

options.text: To summarize the business outcomes the team commits to for the PI
options.rationale: Correct: PI objectives express intended business outcomes and align the team with ART goals.

options.text: To list every user story in the plan
options.rationale: PI objectives summarize outcomes, not an exhaustive story list.
They do not replace iteration backlogs; they describe outcomes.
They are team outcomes, not individual targets.

items.explanation: Correct: PI objectives express intended business outcomes and align the team with ART goals.

items.stem: Which TWO activities are core Product Owner responsibilities during iteration execution? (Select TWO)

options.text: Accepting completed stories against acceptance criteria
options.rationale: Correct: the PO confirms stories meet acceptance criteria.

options.text: Maintaining and refining the team backlog
options.rationale: Correct: ongoing backlog refinement keeps upcoming work ready.
Architectural runway is driven by System Architect/Engineering, not the PO.
Budgeting is a portfolio/Lean Portfolio Management concern, not a PO task.
People management is not a PO responsibility in SAFe.

items.explanation: Correct: the PO confirms stories meet acceptance criteria.
